(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))])
    (let ((seed
           (first (reverse (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v (list 0 1))))
                             (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]
                                         [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))])
                               (at g r c)))))))
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))])
        (set-cell acc r c seed)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((filled (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))])
    (let ((seed
           (first (reverse (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v (list 0 1))))
                             (for*/list ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]
                                         [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))])
                               (at g r c)))))))
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 obj) 1) (obj-r2 obj))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))])
        (set-cell acc r c seed)))))
         (groups (filter (lambda (obj) (not (member (obj-color obj) (list 0 1))))
                         (objects filled 0)))
         (maximum (apply max (map (lambda (obj) (length (obj-cells obj))) groups)))
         (chosen (filter (lambda (obj) (= (length (obj-cells obj)) maximum)) groups)))
    (for*/fold ([out filled]) ([obj (in-list chosen)] [p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
      (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8))))
